reviewScope: Two batches: complete retained text of all 22 breakfast and 30 vegetable-category candidates. Assistant editorial/code review, not cooking validation or clinical approval. Generic source cooking/nutrition remarks remain attributed reference text, not verified dietary advice. Other candidates remain pending.
sourceVerification: Every candidate path exists as a blob in the untruncated HowToCook tree at c694a5c457d45e6e012ae6cd9a7724aab86e320b. This is not the unknown upstream commit used to produce the dataset.

approved.reason: Retained ingredients and pan-frying steps reviewed; text quantities only, no nutrition claims or automated meal suitability. Egg must be cooked through; recipe timing is not a doneness guarantee.

Grain/fruit ingredient and cooking text reviewed as general reference. Preserve 2000ml source water amount; do not call source servings a recommended individual portion. Appliance instructions/capacity take precedence.
Ingredients and wash/stir-fry/simmer sequence reviewed; retain original oil, sugar and salt, no low-fat or therapeutic suitability claim.
Tofu preparation and cooking steps reviewed; fractional blocks remain textual, do not derive grams. Original contribution tip refers to the upstream project shown in sources.
Ingredients and fry/boil sequence reviewed; egg, soy and oyster sauce are visible. Source category is not a vegetarian/allergen guarantee; no personal plan or automatic quantity conversion.
Source explicitly calls for fully set cooked eggs before further frying. Five eggs remain a source batch amount, not recommended per-person intake; no nutrition calculation or allergy clearance.
Reviewed complete ingredients and stir-fry followed by covered cooking. Handful/bag quantities stay textual; all mushrooms and egg tofu require thorough cooking, not a timing guarantee.
Reviewed tofu blanching and fresh assembly. No extended room-temperature storage advice or health claims. Hygiene, ingredient label and personal restrictions remain user checks.

Reviewed washing, blanching, stir-frying and covered cooking. The listed 50ml water is for braising; the separate 1000ml blanching water remains visible in steps. Preserve text quantities without estimating intake or shopping totals.

Reviewed washing, even slicing, steaming, softness check and burn warning. Water is for the steamer, not intake; appliance capacity takes precedence. Generic source nutrition wording is not clinical evidence or a recommendation for a medical condition.

Reviewed complete ingredient and cooking text. Ten-second blanching is followed by stir-frying, not presented as the whole cooking process. Fractional peppers and oil ranges remain textual; source timings and colour are not a guaranteed doneness test.

Reviewed washed florets, blanching and separately boiled garlic sauce. Water splits explicitly into 1000ml and 30ml; optional blanching seasoning remains a source tip, not an inferred shopping amount. Oyster sauce is visible; category and generic nutrient wording are not dietary or allergy certification.

Reviewed all ingredients, spice additions, covered cooking and potato softness check. Small optional water additions and the full source batch remain text; source serving/time estimates and cultural notes are not independently verified, and no personalised portion is inferred.
